title: Shrink and Growth Potions
description: Fun alice in wonderland inspired potions to grow or shrink players and mobs! Use carefully! Survival-obtainable
body:

## Growth and Shrinking Potions

### Backstory

On our survival server, we began using growing and shrinking as fun punishments for hackers and griefers since that seemed to mess up their hacked client systems and fly hacking. This was a harmless form of fun using the new `attribute` system Mojang exposed in 1.20.5, which allowed for scale to be modified. Then we got the bright idea to turn it into actual potions for players to mess with!

### This mod adds

- Potion of Growth
- Potion of Shrinkage
- Splash potions for those
- Arrows for those

### Upcoming
- Potion effects to make the effects temporary, if desired
